01.steps: 1) Go to the Network > ARP page and click on the Flush ARP cache Button. &2) Verify that in the ARP cache table no entry for the DMZ(OPT) interface. &3) Go to the Network > Settings page, configure OPT (DMZ) Interface. &4) Connect PC to the DMZ Interfce &5) Assign PC LAN settings.
01.title: Box added new entries into the ARP cache table, include interface and host
01.result: 1) Verify that new entry was added into the ARP Cache table. &2) Verify that ARP cache table: Internet Address, Physical Address, Interface and Timeout settings for the OPT (DMZ) Interface are correct.&3) Go to ARP Cache table, verify ARP cache have internet address, physical address, interface and Timeout for this PC are correct.

02.steps: 1) unplug pc from the DMZ Interface &2) go to network > settings page and unassigned DMZ interface
02.title: Box deleted entries from the ARP cache table
02.result: 1) Verify DMZ interface entries deleted from the ARP Cache table.

03.steps: 1) On PC enter ipconfig /all to discover MAC address &2) On Network > ARP configuration click add &3) Enter correct IP and incorrect MAC address of PC &3) Click OK &4) verify that entry is listed correctly &5) verify that entry is listed in the ARP cache as Permanent &6) Ping the interface from the PC verify failure. &7) on Network -> ARP configuration click the Edit icon next to the entry created &8) change IP and MAC address of PC to be correct &9) click OK &10) verify that entry is listed correctly. &11) verify that entry is listed in the ARP cache as Permanent. &12) Ping the interface - verify success
03.title: Edit Static ARP Entry

04.steps: 1) On PC enter ipconfig /all to discover MAC address &2) On Network > ARP configuration click Add &3) Enter correct IP and MAC address of PC &4) click OK &5) verify that entry is listed correctly. &6) verify that entry is listed in the ARP cache as Permanent. &7) Ping the interface IP that PC is connected to - verify success &8) change the IP address of the PC &9) ping the interface IP that PC is connected to - verify success &10) verify that dynamic entry has been created that had the same MAC address as the created static one. &11) click to edit the static entry. &12) check the bind MAC address checkbox and click OK &13) ping the interface IP that PC is connected to - verify failure &14) Attempt to add another static mapping to the same MAC address - verify failure &15) change the IP address back &16) ping the interfce - verify success
04.title: Functional test for Bind MAC Address
04.result: 1) once the MAC address is bound to an interface, the SonicWall will not respond to that MAC address on any other interface &2) it will also remove any dynamic cached references to that MAC address that might have been present &3) it will prohibit additinal static mappings of that MAC address

05.steps: 1) On PC enter ipconfig /all to discover MAC address &2) On Network > ARP configuration click Add &3) Enter correct IP and MAC address of PC &4) click OK &5) verify that entry is listed correctly. &6) verify that entry is listed in the ARP cache as Permanent &7) verify that it cannot e deleted from the ARP cache
05.title: verify if the static ARP Entry is published in the ARP cache and is not deletetable
05.result: static ARP entry is published in the ARP Cache and is not deleteable
